oss-hotlist-aggregation-landscape.titleEn: Surveying Open Source Hot-List Aggregators: What You Can Reuse, What You Can Only Borrow
oss-hotlist-aggregation-landscape.summary: 把所有值得知道的中文热榜聚合开源件逐个读到源码级：各自暴露什么、哪些需要 cookie 或签名、许可证的边界在哪。结论是——没有一个能直接当来源层。
oss-hotlist-aggregation-landscape.summaryEn: A source-level audit of every Chinese hot-list aggregator worth knowing — what each one actually exposes, which need cookies or signatures, and where the licence rules cut. Conclusion: none of them can be a source layer as-is.

data-source-feasibility-and-compliance.summary: 哪些平台能用公开接口或 RSS 免凭据读到、哪些必须主动放弃，以及「读公开订阅源」和「爬带签名的接口」之间的线到底画在哪。
data-source-feasibility-and-compliance.summaryEn: What can be read from public endpoints and RSS without a credential, which platform has to be written off, and where the line between reading a public feed and scraping a signed API actually sits.

diversity-ranking-and-ad-filtering-algor.summary: 打破信息茧房的那套算法：跨源事件簇、来源与主题的配额硬上限，以及逐条判定的推广档位——证据不足的条目绝不隐藏。
diversity-ranking-and-ad-filtering-algor.summaryEn: The algorithms behind breaking an information cocoon: cross-source clustering, source and topic quotas as a hard ceiling, and per-item promotion bands that never hide an uncertain item.

electron-python-sidecar-integration.titleEn: An Electron Shell with a Python Sidecar: How It Is Actually Done in 2026
electron-python-sidecar-integration.summary: 进程边界、IPC 契约、打包，以及只有在装到机器上之后才会暴露的坑。全部读真实实现，不读博客。
electron-python-sidecar-integration.summaryEn: Process boundaries, IPC contracts, packaging and the failure modes that only show up after the app is installed — read from real implementations rather than blog posts.

metric-backends.titleEn: Collection Backends for Each Metric, and What They Actually Cost
metric-backends.summary: 监控里的每个指标对应哪个无特权后端能读到，实测读延迟多少，后端消失时降级链该怎么走。
metric-backends.summaryEn: Every metric in the monitor mapped to the backend that can read it without privileges, with measured read latency and the degradation chain when a backend disappears.

temperature-backend-and-degradation.titleEn: Temperature Backend and Its Fallback Chain
temperature-backend-and-degradation.summary: macOS 27 没有公开的 CPU 温度 API，数值只能从一个私有 dylib 读——所以必须标近似值。降级链的终点是「不可用」，绝不是编一个数字出来。
temperature-backend-and-degradation.summaryEn: macOS 27 exposes no public CPU temperature API, so the reading comes from a private dylib — and must therefore be labelled approximate. The fallback chain ends in 'unavailable', never in a fabricated number.

why-no-privileged-component.summary: 安装永远不问管理员密码，于是每个指标都得自己找到无特权的路。这条决定否掉的方案比它开启的多。
why-no-privileged-component.summaryEn: Installing must never ask for an administrator password, so every metric has to find a path that needs no privileges. This decision rules out more than it enables.

private-apis-and-degradation.titleEn: Private APIs, and How to Degrade
private-apis-and-degradation.summary: 哪些私有接口可以用、需要什么探测与缓存，以及符号消失时必须降级而不是崩掉。
private-apis-and-degradation.summaryEn: Which private interfaces are acceptable, what probing and caching they require, and the rule that a missing symbol must produce a stated degradation rather than a crash.
